and I'm the co-founder and CEO of AI21.
AI21 is an AI lab based in Tel Aviv.
Super excited to be here and tell you
about our work around self-optimizing agents.
And so today, we'll speak about these self-evolving AI
systems, why it's needed, why it's hard, and why now.

my wife is asking from me this feature all the time.

seen many of these AI systems actually
shift from experimentation to production.

at the frontier.
